messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU hotpath pool saturation detected for region-us-east-1. 90th pct latency spike + sustained 429s on /v1/generate. Queue growth on hotpath; autoscaler retries failing. Paging oncall alice.

alice: I’m on it. Looking at dashboards now. Can someone paste the pool and tokenbucket metrics? @mira @stuart

stuart: quick dump: hotpath pool used: 100% (all 12 GPUs active), queue length ~ 850 requests, 429s at ~18% of incoming requests. Autoscaler logs show repeated "scale_lock_timeout" and "pool_create_quota" errors. Snip of logs:
```
autoscaler[12:43] ERROR: failed to create pool hotpath-2026-03-16: quota_exceeded
autoscaler[12:43] WARN: tokenbucket reject rate rising for tier:realtime refill=5/s burst=20
scheduler[12:44] INFO: continuous batching backlog: head_queue=850
```

mira: I see tokenbucket refill set very low for the new tier rollout (refill=5/s). That was from the tier-policy change last night (deploy-bot maybe). @deploy-bot recent rollout?

deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-16T00:05: tier-policy v3 applied to prod:realtime. No infra changes.

cs-rebecca: we’re getting 3 customer tickets referencing timeouts and 429s (TKT-3421, TKT-3422, TKT-3424). High-value customers flagged.

support-luis: on the support queue, customers report ~30% error rate on A/B requests since 12:30 UTC. Escalated to priority.

alice: immediate mitigation options — (1) bump tokenbucket refill/burst for realtime tier, (2) temporarily relax strict throttling to soft-drop, (3) manual scale reserve (if quota allows), (4) rollback tier-policy v3. We should pick 1+3 now to reduce customer impact.

bob: confirmed autoscaler couldn't provision extra hotpool due to account pool_quota == 2 (max). That explains quota_exceeded. We can request quota bump but that won’t be immediate. Manual fallback: divert lower-priority traffic to spare pools (if available) or enable burst capacity on dedicated nodes.

mira: I'll bump tokenbucket values for realtime tier and flip enforcement to soft-drop. Applying config now (running control-plane API):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/tiers/realtime/update
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
  -d '{"token_refill": 50, "burst": 200, "enforcement":"soft"}'
```

mira: applied. Confirming propagated to edge proxies.

observability-bot: Metric update: token-refill changed -> 50/s, burst -> 200. 429 rate trending down (12%) but still elevated. Queue length 730 -> 540 in last 3m.

stuart: good to see 429s dipping. Still seeing autoscaler lock issues; logs show a stale create-pool transaction that held the global create lock. I can clear the lock manually to let autoscaler retry. Doing that in 2 min.

alice: go ahead @stuart. Also preparing manual scale command in case pool creation succeeds:
```
redwoodctl scale pool hotpath --replicas 4 --region us-east-1 --reason "mitigation: realtime surge"
```

stuart: cleared stale lock. Autoscaler retried and attempted create; still failing due to pool_quota=2. Request to cloud quota already started by infra last week but not approved.

bob: I can temporarily borrow capacity from our staging quota in us-east-1 if needed. That will cause some staging degradation but better than prod outage. Need approval from product for stage -> prod reassign.

alice: product signoff: @cs-rebecca, support-luis — are we okay to move one staging node to prod for next 90 minutes?

cs-rebecca: yes do it, prioritize impacted customers. Please log the change.

mira: initiated node reassign: tagging staging-gpu-3 -> prod-hotpath. Command: 
```
infractl reassign-node --node staging-gpu-3 --to-pool hotpath --region us-east-1 --ttl 90m
```

observability-bot: Node reassignment complete. New hotpath capacity +1 GPU node; pool usable slots increased. Queue drained to 220. 429s down to 4.5%. Latency regained baseline for most customers.

support-luis: customers in tickets TKT-3421/TKT-3422 report improvement. Marking customer notifications with status update.

alice: now that we have breathing room, we should do a follow-up: (a) rollback tier-policy v3 or update it with higher token refill defaults; (b) request permanent quota bump; (c) add autoscaler health probe to detect create-pool quota failures and alert; (d) add runbook step to check tier-policy before rollouts.

stuart: I’ll open PR to add autoscaler alert and to add a preflight check for tier-policy thresholds. Also will add a temporary probe that automatically flips enforcement to soft when 429>10% for >2m.

mira: I’ll file the quota request and include mitigation notes. Also will add a guard in the CI for tier-policy changes that validates tokenbucket min refill >= 20/s for realtime.

alice: handoff to night oncall @carla — summary: hotpath saturated due to a recent tier-policy rollout that lowered tokenbucket refill, autoscaler couldn't create additional pools because account pool_quota was maxed. Mitigation sequence: bumped token refill and burst, flipped enforcement to soft, reassigned one staging node to prod to temporarily increase capacity, cleared autoscaler lock. 429s now down to ~3-5%. Customer impact: reduced, top tickets updated. Remaining action items: quota bump request, policy rollback or adjustment, CI guard, autoscaler alert.

carla: taking over. Thanks all. Can you drop a short bullet list of open action items and owners?

alice: ACTIONS: alice - ensure customer comms updated; stuart - PR for autoscaler alerts and preflight; mira - quota request + CI guard; bob - coordinate staging capacity reassign logging + postmortem note; cs-rebecca/support-luis - confirm customer closure criteria. ETA for postmortem draft: 24h.

carla: noted. I’ll monitor for next 2h then mark resolved if stable. If 429s climb >8% re-escalate to page.

observability-bot: Final metrics snapshot: queue length 90, 429 rate 3.1%, tokenbucket refill 50/s, burst 200. Incident state: mitigated.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and oncall handoff complete. Closing pager at 1718505080.

carla: thanks team, great fast coordination. Will open postmortem template and assign leads. :thumbsup:
